Lingivo: AI Language Tutor makes language learning practical, personalized, and easy to follow. You can learn languages with AI, improve your vocabulary and comprehension, prepare for interviews and IELTS, and track your progress as you learn.

Have natural conversations with an AI language partner at your own pace. Practice English with AI, improve your fluency, develop clearer responses, and feel more comfortable using the language in real-life situations.

• Learn with Passages and Lessons

Study useful passages and structured lessons designed to support reading, comprehension, vocabulary, grammar, and communication skills. Complete interactive quizzes after each topic to review key points, check your understanding, and reinforce what you have learned.
